note: The two sets are nearly identical in content and accuracy, both correctly capturing the display brightness, movie-night scoring and neighborhood rules, and the Energy Balance thresholds. Set B, however, repeats the 15-minute decathlete visit claim a second time under a slightly different label, adding one more duplicate to a set that already repeats the neighborhood count, house count, no-points threshold and linear-scaling claims. Since both sets are otherwise equally faithful, Set A is marginally better for having one fewer redundant claim.
remarks: Both sets omit the full-points threshold (net electrical energy balance of at least 0 kWh / 'Full points: Net electrical energy >= 0 kWh') and the movie-night scoring mechanics (nine scores averaged and multiplied by maximum available points, 10:30 p.m. submission). Both also contain the same core duplicates: neighborhood count 5, house count 4, no-points threshold -50 kWh, and linear scaling each appear twice; B additionally duplicates the 15-minute visit claim. The 'no points threshold' claims state -50 kWh without the '<=' sign in the value field, though the quote carries it.
